About the Client
Our client is a premier name in the automotive repair industry, renowned for a commitment to excellence that spans over three decades. Operating from a state-of-the-art, state-approved facility, they specialize in restoring vehicles to their pristine, pre-accident condition, with a particular expertise in comprehensive collision repair and high-quality refinishing. They are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Vehicle Painter to join their dedicated team and uphold their reputation for flawless finishes. 

About the Role: 
This role is central to the final and most visible stage of the restoration process. As a Vehicle Painter, you will be entrusted with transforming prepared vehicle bodies with a flawless, factory-quality finish. You will be responsible for colour matching, application, and finishing, ensuring the final product not only meets but exceeds customer expectations. This position requires an artist's eye for detail and a technician's understanding of modern refinishing systems.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Surface Preparation & Masking
• Identify and remove rough spots, imperfections, and old paint from vehicle panels using hand tools and power sanders.
• Mask off areas not requiring paint with precision tape and paper to ensure clean, sharp lines and protect surrounding components.

Paint Matching & Mixing
• Colour match and blend paints to achieve exact shade matches, including metallic and pearl finishes, and select pre-mixed paints as required.
• Adjust tint formulas and test spray-outs to guarantee seamless integration with existing vehicle paintwork.

Application & Finishing
• Apply primer, basecoat, and clearcoat using spray-guns, carefully sanding between coats for a smooth, defect-free surface.
• Perform touch-up repairs, then polish and wax completed paintwork to restore gloss and depth.

Final Detailing & Protection
• Remove masking materials, then wax and polish finished panels to a high lustre.
•Treat vehicles with rust-proofing chemicals and apply protective coatings as needed.

Specialist Work
• Paint custom signs, graphics, and artwork directly onto vehicles when required.

Requirements
• Trade qualification in Automotive Refinishing or Vehicle Painting, or at least 2 years of full-time relevant experience.
• Proven ability to colour match, mix paints, and apply primer, basecoat, and clearcoat using spray-guns in a collision repair environment.
• Strong knowledge of surface preparation, sanding techniques, and masking procedures to achieve defect-free finishes.
• Experience with rust-proofing treatments, polishing, waxing, and final detailing.
• Familiarity with painting signs, graphics, and artwork on vehicles is highly regarded.
• Commitment to workplace health and safety, including proper use of PPE and spray booth protocols.

If you are a skilled Vehicle Painter who takes pride in producing exceptional work and wants to contribute to a business with an outstanding reputation, we encourage you to apply.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

Join the team today and help us make the world a happier place!... yes seriously, that's what we do...  

Join the team and experience the fun and rewarding industry that is mystery shopping! 

We have an online application process we would like you to follow in order to register with us and then be able to start accepting assignments. 

What is the next step?

There are four simple steps to becoming a shopper with us...

1.	Follow this link and register your details on the Secret Customer website https://secret-customer-pty-ltd.clients.app.praemialis.com/registration

2.	Complete the four very simple compliance tests located in the members areas of the website, all tests must be passed at 100% and can be taken as many times as you like.

3.	You will then be emailed instructions on how to complete the online virtual visit using our online reporting system.

4.	Once you have submitted this report it will be reviewed and if accepted you will be sent an email explaining what to do to allow you to start accepting jobs online! If you have any further questions you can call us on 1300 88 33 16 or email us at enquiries @ secretcustomer.com.au 

If you are still not sure, here are some FAQ that may be useful to you:

Why become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra income whist doing the things you already do and enjoy. Your assignments might be to visit a local café or restaurant, cinema, local attraction or another local business. You simply visit your chosen location as you would as a normal paying customer, once you have finished your visit you fill out an online questionnaire explaining how the visit went and what you observed whilst you were there. You are then reimbursed up to your allowance, which is explained before you go, and paid an additional payment on top of that.

How much am I paid per job?

The payments per job vary based on how long the assignment may take and how much is involved, you will be emailed all the detail including the amount being offered for payment for each job and then you choose to accept the job if you wish. You will be paid a minimum of $20 per job up to a maximum of $150

How many jobs do I have to do?

You can choose to do as many or as few as you like, you are not obligated to do a specific number so you get to choose the ones you really want. 

How many jobs can I expect?

There are no guarantees of any number of jobs as it all depends on the areas you have chosen to work and the clients we are working with at the time. You will be alerted by email when jobs become available. If you wish to make Mystery Shopping a regular part of your income then we suggest you register with a few agencies so you have a regular flow of work. – This is not a position that you would be able to make what you might refer to as a ‘normal full time wage’. It is a position that you would do to earn extra cash to supplement your current role, or as a part time hobby.

How am I paid?

After your report has been accepted by our QA team you will be paid within 14 days, straight into your nominated bank account. 

How do I find out about jobs? 

You will be emailed about jobs that become available in your chosen areas.

Do I need an ABN number? 

An ABN number is a great idea to have if you are looking to do Mystery shopping on a regular basis, alternatively, if it suits your personal tax situation you can send us a completed ‘Statement By Supplier’ form that you can download from the ATO website.  

Will I be an employee of Secret Customer Australia? 

No, you will a subcontractor and therefore must sort out your own tax at the end of the financial year.

Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst

Kogan People Solutions are delighted to be working with a local government powerhouse in Melbourne’s southeast, who wish to appoint a qualified skilled and experienced Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst.

The newly appointed Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst will coordinate the collection, maintenance, and reporting of Council’s GIS and spatial databases to ensure a "single source of truth" enhance spatial systems to support business units, optimize data integration for modelling, and deliver GIS training and support across the organization.

Location – Dandenong Vic

Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing

Salary – Offered in the range $95k to $105k plus superannuation, per annum 

Key Responsibilities of this exciting position include

System Development & Management

•	Platform Administration: Manage and enhance QGIS, IntraMaps, Mapbox, and related spatial systems to expand corporate utility.

•	Integration: Integrate GIS with corporate databases, the Property Information System, and Asset Management Systems to ensure data quality and system functionality.

•	Data Governance: Coordinate spatial data collection (including GPS data) and ensure compliance with external data agreements.
Business Analysis & Reporting

•	Data Interrogation: Utilize GIS and SQL query tools to extract, analyze, and interrogate spatial data for ad-hoc business requirements.

•	Reporting & Presentation: Create, map, and professionally present spatial and textual information for performance reporting and publications.

Customer Support & Vendor Management

•	Support & Training: Provide technical support, document user requests, prepare training materials, and deliver non-technical GIS training to internal staff.

•	Collaboration: Facilitate the bi-monthly GIS User Group and maintain effective working relationships with software vendors and contractors.
Continuous Improvement & Governance

•	Process Optimization: Review GIS workflows via process mapping and assist in developing industry-best-practice policies and procedures.

•	Change Management: Adhere to operational procedures for IT services, focusing on system testing and change management principles.

To be considered, we expect to be able to observe:

Education and Professional Memberships

•	Degree Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, or a relevant IT field.

•	Professional Association: Membership (or eligibility for membership) with a professional geospatial body requiring Continuing Professional Development (CPD), such as the Geospatial Council of Australia (formerly SSSI) or GITA.

Technical Skills & Experience

•	GIS & Database Admin: Proven experience developing, implementing, and administering GIS systems, SQL servers, and databases (Local Government experience preferred).

•	Data Querying: Demonstrated ability to interrogate complex spatial data using spatialized SQL queries.

•	Analytical & Communication Skills: Strong problem-solving capabilities, paired with the ability to communicate technical GIS concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Mandatory Licences & Pre-Employment Checks

The following credentials must be held (or obtained) prior to commencement and maintained throughout employment:

•	Current valid Victorian Driver’s Licence

•	Satisfactory National Police Check

•	Satisfactory Working with Children Check (WWCC)

Interested?

Please express interest to the recruiters Kogan People Solutions quoting reference # 6189-FS, using the facilities on this website.

We can only respond to shortlisted candidates and apologise in advance if we don’t respond to your application.

result.description:
Evolve Physiotherapy Centre is seeking a full-time Junior / Grade One to Mid-Level Physiotherapist to join their expert team in Jacana, Victoria. Evolve is a multidisciplinary clinic providing hands-on, evidence-based physiotherapy care, guided by the philosophy that "movement is medicine”.

Description


Evolve Physiotherapy Centre believes healthcare should be seamless, professional and genuinely patient-centred. Located in Melbourne's north-west, the clinic is built on a simple philosophy: treat every patient with respect, care and professionalism, while creating an environment where both patients and team members can thrive.

Evolve prides itself on running on time, communicating clearly, delivering exceptional care and building long-term relationships with its patients and local community.

As the clinic continues to grow, they're looking for a motivated Junior / Grade One to Mid-Level Physiotherapist to join their team.

About the Role


This is an opportunity to work within a supportive, growth-focused environment where you'll have the autonomy to develop your own clinical style while receiving ongoing mentorship and guidance.

You'll work with a diverse patient caseload across musculoskeletal physiotherapy, helping patients move better, recover from injury and achieve meaningful long-term outcomes.

You'll also have opportunities to become involved in community engagement initiatives, sporting club relationships and professional development opportunities that align with your interests


Key Duties:


•	Conduct comprehensive musculoskeletal, neurological and functional assessments — administering muscle, nerve, joint and functional ability tests — to identify and diagnose patients' physical impairments

•	Design and implement individualised, evidence-based treatment programs for patients presenting with musculoskeletal injuries, chronic pain, sports injuries, WorkCover/TAC-related conditions and other disorders

•	Apply manual therapy techniques, including spinal and peripheral joint mobilisation/manipulation, dry needling and therapeutic cupping, to relieve pain, restore joint mobility and improve movement

•	Prescribe and progress individualised, gym-based exercise programs to strengthen muscles, restore functional movement, and improve patients' balance and coordination

•	Educate patients and their families on their condition, injury prevention, recovery expectations and long-term self-management to support healthy, sustainable outcomes

•	Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation of assessments, treatment plans and progress notes in line with professional and regulatory standards

•	Manage an individual patient caseload across musculoskeletal, sports, chronic pain, WorkCover/TAC and NDIS home-visit clients, liaising with referring practitioners as required

•	Collaborate with other clinicians and support staff, and participate in team meetings and professional development activities, to support coordinated, high-quality patient care


Requirements

•	Hold a Bachelor Degree or higher qualification in Physiotherapy.

•	Currently hold Limited or Full Registration for Supervised Practice with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA). Persons holding limited registration will be expected to move towards full during employment.

•	At least 12 months experience practising as a physiotherapist.

•	Sound clinical assessment, treatment planning and manual therapy skills.

•	Strong communication skills for patient education and interdisciplinary liaison.

•	Commitment to evidence-based, patient-centred practice.

•	Experience or training in musculoskeletal, sports, neurological or vestibular rehabilitation is desirable.

•	Additional certification in Pilates-based rehabilitation, kinesiology taping, or dry needling will be viewed favourably.


Salary: 	        $77,000 - $95,000 per annum + superannuation

Location: 	36 Bamburgh St, Jacana VIC 3047

Type: 		Full Time


We will be accepting applications  until midnight Sunday 23rd August 2026. We are looking for someone to start as soon as possible.


This ad has been posted by Clear Cut Recruitment on behalf of Evolve Physiotherapy Centre Pty Ltd.

Join the team today and help us make the world a happier place!... yes seriously, that's what we do...  

Join the team and experience the fun and rewarding industry that is mystery shopping! 

We have an online application process we would like you to follow in order to register with us and then be able to start accepting assignments. 

What is the next step?

There are four simple steps to becoming a shopper with us...

1.	Follow this link and register your details on the Secret Customer website https://secret-customer-pty-ltd.clients.app.praemialis.com/registration

If you are still not sure, here are some FAQ that may be useful to you:

Why become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra income whist doing the things you already do and enjoy. Your assignments might be to visit a local café or restaurant, cinema, local attraction or another local business. You simply visit your chosen location as you would as a normal paying customer, once you have finished your visit you fill out an online questionnaire explaining how the visit went and what you observed whilst you were there. You are then reimbursed up to your allowance, which is explained before you go, and paid an additional payment on top of that.

How much am I paid per job?

The payments per job vary based on how long the assignment may take and how much is involved, you will be emailed all the detail including the amount being offered for payment for each job and then you choose to accept the job if you wish. You will be paid a minimum of $20 per job up to a maximum of $150

How many jobs do I have to do?

You can choose to do as many or as few as you like, you are not obligated to do a specific number so you get to choose the ones you really want. 

How many jobs can I expect?

There are no guarantees of any number of jobs as it all depends on the areas you have chosen to work and the clients we are working with at the time. You will be alerted by email when jobs become available. If you wish to make Mystery Shopping a regular part of your income then we suggest you register with a few agencies so you have a regular flow of work. – This is not a position that you would be able to make what you might refer to as a ‘normal full time wage’. It is a position that you would do to earn extra cash to supplement your current role, or as a part time hobby.

How am I paid?

After your report has been accepted by our QA team you will be paid within 14 days, straight into your nominated bank account. 

How do I find out about jobs? 

You will be emailed about jobs that become available in your chosen areas.

Do I need an ABN number? 

An ABN number is a great idea to have if you are looking to do Mystery shopping on a regular basis, alternatively, if it suits your personal tax situation you can send us a completed ‘Statement By Supplier’ form that you can download from the ATO website.  

Will I be an employee of Secret Customer Australia? 

No, you will a subcontractor and therefore must sort out your own tax at the end of the financial year.
